items.title: [Steam论坛] The Standard Banner is Taunting Me, lol
items.summary:
I'm 1 enlighten away from getting Celeste +12, & suddenly she's nowhere to be found. Used to feel like I couldn't swing a stick in any direction without getting her every few 5*s, & now I'm up to a streak of 10 without her. I got  Miryam  before her last enlighten. (yes I'm aware it's just rng & bias because I'm actively aiming for something specific now, but it's almost kind of funny now) Perhaps posting about it will invoke the sacred 'the minute you complain it fixes itself' spell.

Have any
items.author: rosesnowflakes
